observations: Photo 0 shows a black Samsung monitor from the front, with the brand name visible below the screen. The screen is off and reflects light. The monitor has a thick bezel and a circular base.

Photo 1 shows the back of the same monitor, with the Samsung logo centered. A label with specifications is visible below the logo, but the text is too small to read clearly. The monitor is placed on a tiled floor, surrounded by boxes and other electronics.
The monitor appears to be in used condition with visible smudges and reflections on the screen and back panel.
No HDMI ports or other ports are visible in the photos.
The seller claims it is a 23-inch Samsung HDMI monitor.

claims.evidence: The brand Samsung is visible in photo 0 and photo 1, but the size (23 inches) and HDMI capability are not verifiable from the photos. The model number is unreadable in photo 1, and no ports are visible.

risks.risk: The monitor may not be 23 inches as claimed.
risks.proof: A photo showing the monitor next to a ruler or a known-sized object for scale, or a clear shot of the model number which can be cross-referenced for screen size.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a smaller or unknown-sized monitor, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The monitor may not have HDMI ports as claimed.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the back or side of the monitor showing the ports, specifically confirming the presence of an HDMI port.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a monitor without HDMI, which reduces value for buyers needing HDMI connectivity.

risks.risk: The monitor may be non-functional or have screen defects (e.g., dead pixels, backlight issues).
risks.proof: A video or photo of the monitor turned on, displaying a test pattern or image, to confirm functionality and screen quality.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which significantly reduces value.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the model number label on the back of the monitor.
A close-up photo of the ports on the back or side of the monitor, showing HDMI and other connections.
A photo or video of the monitor turned on, displaying a clear image to confirm functionality and screen condition.
A photo showing the monitor next to a known-sized object to verify the 23-inch size.
response.reason: The brand is confirmed as Samsung, but the size, HDMI capability, and functionality are unverified. Without proof of these claims, the item cannot be priced accurately and carries significant hidden risks that affect value.
